Class ControllerAdminHomeNew

java.lang.Object
guiAdminHomeNew.ControllerAdminHomeNew
public class ControllerAdminHomeNew extends Object

Title: ControllerAdminHomeNew Class.

Description: Controller for the new Admin Home Page. Handles invitation sending, email validation, logout, and navigation. User management actions (delete, one-time password, add/remove roles) are handled directly in AdminUserManagementPanel.

Version:
1.00 Initial implementation, 1.01 2026-06-08 Improved invalidEmailAddress with format validation (Kyle Kim)
Author:
James Suchovic (Team 3) - Designed and implemented account setup UI, navigation flow, layout structure, and functionality, Kyle Kim (Team 3) - Improved email validation
